item.title: #accessibility in Github Copilot chat: Screenreader announces all copilot's path references and links as URL encoded file paths

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue identified by VS Code Team member as probable bug

item.body:
Type: Bug Hello. When I receive a message from github copilot and there is a file path & location reference, NVDA screenreader announces the reference as a github copilot markdown command with URL encoded file path that is badly understandable with screenreader. Same occurres in accessible view. Here's an example of copilot's message. I copied it from accessible view, but exactly the same is pronounced by screenreader, including the github.copilot.open_relative_path and a very very long string of url encoded something. ``` From the provided excerpt of the [`todo.md`](command:_github.copilot.openRelativePath?%5B%7B%22scheme%22%3A%22file%22%2C%22authority%22%3A%22%22%2C%22path%22%3A%22%2FC%3A%2FUsers%2FUser%2Ffiles%2Fpythons%2Fmachine-building-knowledge-aggregator-bot%2Ftodo.md%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%2C%22fragment%22%3A%22%22%7D%5D "c:\Users\User\files\pythons\machine-building-knowledge-aggregator-bot\todo.md") file, the only unchecked item in the first sublist is: ``` Expected behaviour: Screenreader only announces the file path without the copilot command.
